from.place: the closure argument for cones and countable direct sums in the proof of Lemma 06YS

title: Cones and countable direct sums of K-flat complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. If $(K_n^\bullet)_{n\in\mathbf N}$ is a countable family of K-flat complexes of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex], then $\bigoplus_n K_n^\bullet$ is K-flat, and the mapping cone of every morphism of K-flat complexes is K-flat.
